purpose: Fatal pre-2024 validation of a Bybit-native latent parent-order exhaustion signal before any 2024 official evaluation data are opened.
venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

event_reconstruction.child_cluster: Contiguous public trades with identical exchange timestamp and identical taker side are aggregated into one aggressive child cluster.

schedule_detection.period_estimator: median of the three completed inter-event gaps
schedule_detection.causality: The schedule is recognized only after the fourth child cluster is fully observed.

state_filters.sequence_move_measurement: Taker-side-signed price change from the first child timestamp plus 100 ms to the fourth child timestamp plus 100 ms.
state_filters.miss_rule: No same-side, same-fingerprint child has arrived by forecast_time + max(100 ms, 10% of inferred period).
state_filters.post_detection_measurement: Taker-side-signed price change from fourth-child time plus 100 ms to the causal miss decision; non-positive means relaxation has begun.
state_filters.prior_trend_measurement_end: Immediately before the first child cluster of the recognized four-child sequence.
state_filters.economic_interpretation: The scheduled metaorder temporarily pushes against an established one-hour trend; after its expected next child fails to arrive and price starts relaxing, trade for resumption of the prior trend.

execution.entry: Opposite the detected schedule side at the first public trade at or after the causal miss decision plus latency.
execution.exit: First public trade at or after entry plus 3600 seconds.
execution.global_slot: At most one BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT position. Simultaneous eligible signals are ranked by completed schedule regularity and observed notional only.
execution.funding: This is a fatal alpha screen. Any survivor must subsequently be replayed with exact historical Bybit funding and bid/ask execution; no 2024 result may be ranked before that replay.

selection_history.reason_for_prior_trend_filter: The unfiltered rule remained positive on mean at high cost but failed top-trade removal. A rounded 20 bp countertrend threshold was chosen from the causal mechanism and a broad neighboring threshold plateau, not from the unopened validation dates.

next_action: Open only the four listed 2023 validation dates. If the gate fails, do not open 2024 for this rule and return to alpha search.
